subject_conventions.controller: The card's controller's resources or action, including imperative spell text ("Draw a card").
subject_conventions.opponent: An opponent's resources or action ("each opponent", "each other player", "an opponent casts").
subject_conventions.any_player: No player restriction is stated ("whenever a creature dies", "any target", "target creature").
subject_conventions.unknown: A player determined only at resolution ("its controller", "that player").

sources.authorship: Cases and annotations authored for this project on 2026-09-08 from a reading of each text, using the conventions above; annotations were written before scoring and independently of extractor output.
sources.text_provenance: Oracle-style texts follow printed Commander-legal cards as remembered by the author and were not fetched from a live Scryfall snapshot; a few cases are synthetic minimal-pair texts and carry names that are not printed cards. Exact wording may differ from current Oracle text.
sources.annotation_protocol: expect: assertions that must be produced (pattern, subject, condition, optional face). reject: assertions that count as false positives anywhere. complete: every produced supported annotation must match an expectation. expect_unmodeled / expect_uncertain: at least one span with that status must be reported.
sources.holdout_policy: Holdout cases are frozen: the test pins the sha256 of the holdout subset. Extractor changes may be motivated only by calibration failures; a changed holdout digest must be justified in review as an annotation correction, never as tuning.
limitations: Precision is measured on the extractor's own supported catalog; unsupported behavior is reported, not scored as correct.
Synthetic minimal pairs test contrasts the extractor must respect and are labeled by non-printed names.
Texts are not a live Oracle corpus; production behavior on current Scryfall wording may differ.
No rules interpretation, playability or synergy quality is claimed by any annotation.
